separate_lead_report.reason: Historical CF rows have source time/value but not their original Kalshi receipt time. A causal lead test cannot mix BRTI source time with book receive time.

settlement_crosscheck.rule: Exactly the 60 source timestamps close-60s through close-1s must exist; raw mean>=floor_strike must match official result.

book_replay.rule: Causal order=(recv_wall_ns,recv_mono_ns,ws_seq); snapshot replaces, signed delta adds; any missing/ambiguous clock or semantics, delta-before-snapshot, or negative quantity rejects the full market stream. No clamping or repair.
